standard: Visible refinement acceptable at application scale; not a numerical quality score or release approval.

front.note: The two flower sprays, supported stems and basal leaves remain a distinct orchid silhouette with a clean ceramic pot.

rear.note: Rear petals, stem clips and leaf attachments remain connected without missing backs.

detail.note: The pot rim, soil, support ties and layered basal leaves read clearly; the flowers retain their stylized individual petals.

underside.note: The pot has a closed base and the leaf cluster remains seated within its rim.

clay.note: The neutral view preserves the slender branching sprays and separated leaves; no coarse stacked plant surrogate appears.

front.note: The white spathes and veined pointed leaves read immediately as a flowering peace lily.

rear.note: The rear view preserves asymmetric leaf heights and two distinct flower stems.

detail.note: Leaf veins, curved spathes and visible soil provide legible construction at application scale.

underside.note: The ceramic base is closed and the stems emerge coherently from the pot.

clay.note: The neutral view keeps individual folded leaves and shaped flowers rather than a solid foliage mass.

front.note: The upright variegated blades remain distinct, with varied heights and a stable terracotta pot.

rear.note: Rear blades retain their separate tapered silhouettes and green edge variation.

detail.note: The blade markings, modeled folds and inset soil remain readable without detached leaf pieces.

underside.note: The closed pot base and dense blade roots remain connected inside the rim.

clay.note: The neutral silhouette retains the narrow, upright species habit and individually modeled blades.

front.note: The paired leaves on multiple stems remain a recognizable ZZ plant with a clean low pot.

rear.note: Rear branches show overlapping individual leaflets with varied stem heights.

detail.note: Leaf attachments and layered leaflets read cleanly above visible soil; the lower canopy remains intentionally dense.

underside.note: The closed pot base supports the full stem cluster without visible gaps.

clay.note: The neutral view confirms separate stems and leaflets; the compact stylized crown remains acceptable at application scale.

front.note: The hopper, angled burr housing, discharge chute and dosing cup form a coherent single-dose grinder.

rear.note: The rear service panel and housing remain closed and connected above the base.

detail.note: The knurled adjustment ring and short outlet are clear; the cup sits directly below the discharge path.

underside.note: Four feet, the base plate and casing are complete from beneath.

clay.note: The neutral form preserves distinct hopper, grinder and cup construction with restrained rounded edges.

front.note: The transparent bowl, feed chute, sealed lid and separate control base remain a recognizable processor.

rear.note: The rear handle and bowl attachments remain continuous and the motor enclosure is closed.

detail.note: Blades, measurement marks and layered lid seals remain visible; the square handle is a deliberate formed shape without a pinched sweep.

underside.note: The bowl support and four feet remain connected to the base from below.

clay.note: The neutral view preserves the device's separate functional components and a coherent compact silhouette.

front.note: The rounded body, pressure lid and carrying handle retain a distinct compact appliance shape.

rear.note: The rear lid seam and handle supports remain joined with no open casing.

detail.note: The lid gasket, vent and readable segmented display have clear separation; controls remain seated.

underside.note: Four feet and the lower casing remain complete and clean.

clay.note: The neutral view confirms restrained edge rounding and layered lid construction, with the inherited rectangular pressure-cooker styling retained.

front.note: The simple cabinet retains clean front reveals, a thin pull detail and a recessed toe kick.

rear.note: The rear panel and side panels are closed, aligned and evenly finished.

detail.note: Door edges, the top gap and the dark pull line remain crisp without excessive beveling.

underside.note: The recessed plinth supports the cabinet and stays within its original footprint.

clay.note: The neutral view retains a straightforward fitted cabinet with coherent panel thickness and no added clutter.

front.note: The upholstered frame, layered mattress and two pillows remain connected and clearly legible.

rear.note: The rear headboard remains smooth and aligned with the low bed frame.

detail.note: The pillow piping is seated continuously and the cover retains restrained matching-color quilting without the earlier floating welt.

underside.note: The recessed supporting base is closed and bedding stays within the original frame.

clay.note: The neutral view preserves the tailored mattress and pillow forms; the bedding remains intentionally tidy rather than heavily draped.

front.note: The solid hutch and separate wire run read clearly, with repeated connected cage arches and an entry opening.

rear.note: The rear service panel and roof remain closed while the wire run retains its open ground-facing design.

detail.note: Individual mesh wires, arch rails and the dark hutch opening remain legible; dense wire overlap is consistent with the enclosure.

underside.note: The hutch floor is closed and the run remains intentionally open to the ground.

clay.note: The neutral view preserves the coherent shelter-and-run arrangement with its original thin wire construction.

front.note: The purple display figure, boots and round base retain the original stylized character silhouette.

rear.note: Layered hair and costume sections remain distinct and connected at the back.

detail.note: Face features, buttons and separated skirt panels remain readable without new material artifacts.

underside.note: Both boots remain seated on the closed base, and the narrow prop remains attached.

clay.note: The neutral view preserves the intentional miniature figurine styling; no claim of anatomical realism is made.

front.note: The ribbed barrel retains a clear lid, lower tap and grounded cylindrical body.

rear.note: The rear connection port and repeated bands remain aligned without gaps through the wall.

detail.note: The lid seam, gently rounded bands and tap read coherently with restrained surface detail.

underside.note: The dark closed base and lower tap attachment are intact.

clay.note: The neutral silhouette remains a clean storage barrel with consistent circular bands and its original proportions.

front.note: The planted timber bed retains a dense arrangement of individually modeled stems, leaves and flowers.

rear.note: Rear planting density and layered timber boards remain consistent without floating clusters.

detail.note: Visible flower centers, petals, leaf blades and timber grain improve surface readability while retaining the original planting.

underside.note: The wooden bed has a closed base, and the plants remain rooted within its soil footprint.

clay.note: The neutral view confirms varied flower heights and separate botanical parts above layered frame boards.

front.note: Four burners, a contrasting hob, control knobs and an oven door form a clear compact range.

rear.note: The rear enclosure and vent panel remain closed and aligned with the hob.

detail.note: Burner supports, circular control faces and the oven handle are distinct with restrained metallic highlights.

underside.note: The lower enclosure is complete and the door remains separated from its frame.

clay.note: The neutral view retains recognizable layered appliance construction without changing the footprint.

front.note: The articulated wall lamp remains recognizable, but the shade reads as a visibly polygonal cone.

rear.note: The original arm pivots and wall plate remain connected; the cone's flat facets also show from the rear.

detail.note: Full-size inspection shows broad alternating flat faces across the spun shade. Smooth the original thin conical shell while preserving its openings and diffuser.

underside.note: The original underside light remains visible within the dark shade; this is a surface silhouette issue, not evidence of a missing bulb.

clay.note: The neutral view retains the correct articulated structure but still needs a smoother conical shade outline.

front.note: The trim plate, dark recessed housing and contrasting bezel remain a coherent ceiling downlight.

rear.note: The back plate and housing remain closed and concentric.

detail.note: The layered trim and cylindrical can are legible; minor side shading segmentation is unobtrusive at application scale.

underside.note: The underside shows the recessed light disc and nested bezel clearly; the disc is an intentional diffuser.

clay.note: The neutral view preserves the compact mount and the original layered circular construction.

front.note: Five evenly spaced cells remain aligned beneath the long mounting plate.

rear.note: The rear view retains consistent housing depth and regular spacing across all five lights.

detail.note: Contrasting bezels and dark cans remain distinct with no merged or missing cells.

underside.note: All five diffuser faces remain visible and aligned from below.

clay.note: The neutral silhouette preserves a coherent five-cell linear fixture with clean plate edges.

front.note: The single round trim plate and dark housing remain centered and clearly layered.

rear.note: The rear mount stays closed and its circular proportions are unchanged.

detail.note: The plate edge and contrasting bezel read cleanly without unrelated decorative additions.

underside.note: The diffuser is clearly inset within the dark inner ring and remains complete.

clay.note: The neutral view retains the original compact circular downlight construction.

front.note: The square mounting plate remains distinct above its circular downlight housing.

rear.note: The plate corners and housing attachment remain clean and connected.

detail.note: The squared plate, dark cylinder and fine brass bezel remain legible; the small bezel facets are acceptable at application scale.

underside.note: The lower diffuser and concentric recess remain visible without gaps in the housing.

clay.note: The neutral view confirms the original square-to-round layered fixture silhouette.

front.note: Two matching round housings remain evenly seated beneath one rectangular plate.

rear.note: The rear view retains equal housing depth and clean plate edges.

detail.note: Both contrasting bezels remain separate and consistently proportioned.

underside.note: The two diffuser discs are complete and evenly recessed from below.

clay.note: The neutral view preserves the deliberate paired downlight construction and balanced spacing.

front.note: The vessel retains a genuine deep rectangular recess and substantial porcelain walls.

rear.note: The rear view shows a closed wall and consistent rim height around the bowl.

detail.note: Full-size inspection confirms a clean recessed interior and thick joined walls. The inherited panel seams remain a stylized fabricated-basin detail.

underside.note: The base is closed and the outer walls remain joined around it without a new opening.

clay.note: The neutral form is an immediately recognizable rectangular vessel basin; drain visibility is limited by the low viewing angle.

front.note: The reeded cabinet and twin bowls remain well organized, but both porcelain basins have visibly angular rim and inner-wall transitions.

rear.note: The rear cabinet, taps and worktop remain coherent; the basin corners need smoother continuity.

detail.note: Full-size inspection shows broad planar bowl facets around the rounded corners. Refine only the measured basin contours and preserve cabinet reeds and hardware.

underside.note: The cabinet base and legs are clean and supported; no underside cabinet repair is needed.

clay.note: The neutral view confirms the cabinet construction is strong, while the two basin silhouettes retain conspicuous angular corners.

front.note: The original glass tank, fish, reef planting and textured cabinet remain intact with restrained exterior casework detail.

rear.note: Rear glazing, cabinet panels and the internal reef composition remain readable and unchanged in character.

detail.note: The fish, plants, rocks and sand retain their original protected fidelity; added exterior detail does not intrude into the tank.

underside.note: The cabinet base is closed and the tank remains supported above the cabinet.

clay.note: The neutral view confirms the glass enclosure and cabinet structure. Aquarium internals remain protected rather than simplified.

front.note: The paired tall doors and separate lower drawer form a clear refrigerator silhouette.

rear.note: The rear shell is closed and smoothly connected to the side panels.

detail.note: The long handles, door reveals and lower pull remain seated with clean rounded edges.

underside.note: The recessed lower base and drawer separation remain complete from beneath.

clay.note: The neutral view preserves the original appliance proportions and distinct door construction.

front.note: The upper cabinet retains two framed ribbed-glass doors and a clean top panel.

rear.note: The rear carcass and side panel remain closed and aligned.

detail.note: The repeated glass ribs, door frames and top reveals remain distinct without surface tearing.

underside.note: Both doors and the cabinet base remain joined; ribbed reflections are consistent with the glass construction.

clay.note: The neutral view retains the original framed two-door cabinet silhouette and individual rib detail.

front.note: The broad island retains four reeded doors, a simple worktop and a recessed plinth.

rear.note: The plain rear panel remains closed and provides a clean counterpart to the reeded front.

detail.note: The worktop edge, vertical reeds and thin pulls remain evenly aligned and legible.

underside.note: The recessed supporting base stays inside the original cabinet footprint.

clay.note: The neutral view confirms coherent cabinetry and restrained panel thickness across the wide island.

front.note: The fluted pedestal is clear, but the round tabletop and foot retain visible polygonal outline steps.

rear.note: The rear silhouette repeats the same faceted circular top and lower foot.

detail.note: Full-size inspection shows broad flat tabletop edge segments above the well-defined vertical flutes. Smooth the original turned top and foot profiles.

underside.note: The pedestal remains supported between the top and foot; preserve these contacts and the existing flute arrangement.

clay.note: The neutral view confirms a coherent pedestal table whose two large round boundaries need denser smooth sampling.

front.note: The small cooker is recognizable, but its main body and white lid remain strongly polygonal.

rear.note: The rear shell repeats the visible flat radial sides and irregular lid outline.

detail.note: Full-size inspection shows a faceted lid perimeter and abrupt circular body facets. Preserve controls and lid hardware while refining the original turned profiles.

underside.note: The closed bottom and existing control panel remain intact; the silhouette repair should preserve their placement.

clay.note: The neutral view exposes the coarse cylindrical outline clearly, so material refinement alone is insufficient.

front.note: The extended chaise, three seat cushions and connected back retain a coherent upholstered sectional silhouette.

rear.note: The full rear support remains continuous beneath the separate back cushions.

detail.note: The matte upholstery has restrained grain and softly tailored corners without floating trims or unsupported cushion gaps.

underside.note: The closed base and visible metal feet remain attached beneath the original seating footprint.

clay.note: The neutral view preserves recognizable tailored cushions and a supported chaise with no added loose side pillows.

front.note: The six globes and suspension layout remain clear, but the circular metal frame has a visibly segmented outline.

rear.note: The rear frame repeats the angular ring construction while the globes and suspension remain coherent.

detail.note: Full-size inspection shows broad alternating facets across the ring stock. Smooth the existing ring while preserving globe stems and all suspension contacts.

underside.note: The six globe positions and support wires remain intact; only the coarse circular frame needs refinement.

clay.note: The neutral view retains the correct chandelier layout but the primary ring should read as continuous formed metal.

front.note: The camera panel, illuminated button ring and speaker marks form a clear compact doorbell.

rear.note: The rear mounting face remains closed and aligned with the rounded metal enclosure.

detail.note: The lens, button and small speaker slots remain distinct; fine surface texture does not obscure the controls.

underside.note: The lower enclosure and button remain joined without missing surfaces.

clay.note: The neutral view preserves clean component layering and the original narrow wall-mounted silhouette.

front.note: The layered dial remains legible, but the steel case has a prominent coarse checked surface unlike the smoother original preview.

rear.note: Full-size rear inspection shows a repeated dimple/checker pattern across the hemisphere that reads as patterned rubber rather than satin steel.

detail.note: Hands, minute marks, date window and identity remain clear; retain these details while correcting only the case surface scale.

underside.note: The case remains closed and the dial layers remain seated, so no geometric or dial simplification is warranted.

clay.note: The neutral view confirms a coherent hemispherical clock case; the blocking defect is the newly coarse metallic surface response.

front.note: The tall hanging rail, adjustable uprights and low shelf remain a clear freestanding clothes rack.

rear.note: The rear frame remains straight and connected at both uprights and lower rails.

detail.note: Adjustment collars and the slender rail joints are readable with restrained metallic highlights.

underside.note: The lower support rails and small wheels remain attached within the original stance.

clay.note: The neutral silhouette retains the intentionally open rack construction without invented clothing or extra panels.

front.note: Seven drawer fronts, contrasting top and side handle remain a clear wheeled tool cabinet.

rear.note: The rear cabinet is closed and the casters remain seated below it.

detail.note: Drawer reveals, pulls and the side handle remain clean and consistently aligned.

underside.note: All four casters and the lower cabinet surface remain connected from below.

clay.note: The neutral view preserves the original seven-drawer construction and supported rolling base.

front.note: The raised curb, dark external frame and inset glazing remain a clear flat-roof skylight.

rear.note: The rear corner joints and glazing border remain aligned without open gaps.

detail.note: The layered frame, inner curb and transparent pane remain legible with clean edge separation.

underside.note: The open curb interior and retained glass remain consistent with a skylight assembly rather than a solid block.

clay.note: The neutral view preserves the original framed aperture and substantial curb thickness.

front.note: The four-arm rotary frame and nested clothes lines remain clear above the central pole.

rear.note: The rear view retains even line spacing and connected radial arms.

detail.note: The central collar, braces and taut line attachments remain coherent without loose isolated wires.

underside.note: The pole, central bracing and arm structure remain joined when viewed from beneath.

clay.note: The neutral silhouette preserves the deliberately thin open clothesline construction and its original footprint.
